summary: The next 18 days are unusually dense: the Fed decision lands one day before HOOD earnings, then jobs, HIMS earnings, and CPI follow. HOOD and HIMS options are already pricing violent two-sided moves. ABT has no confirmed hard catalyst inside the eight-week window, which makes it the quiet name in a loud tape.

events.title: Federal Reserve rate decision and press conference
events.implication: This sets the discount-rate backdrop hours before HOOD reports. A hawkish surprise would hit high-duration HOOD and HIMS harder than defensive ABT; a dovish read reverses that pressure.
events.direction: Two-sided; hawkish is bearish HOOD/HIMS and relatively supportive for ABT, while dovish is the mirror image.
events.magnitude: Broad-market event; no ticker-specific move estimate is claimed. Treat the HOOD earnings straddle separately because the two events overlap.
events.action: Do not read the HOOD earnings setup without first recording the statement, vote, and Powell's inflation/growth language.
events.invalidation: A fully expected decision with unchanged guidance and a muted rates reaction.
events.watch: 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields, QQQ reaction, and whether rate-sensitive equities hold the first 30-minute move.

events.title: Robinhood Q2 2026 earnings
events.implication: The print tests whether net deposits and platform assets are making growth durable enough to justify a roughly 51× trailing P/E, rather than leaving the story dependent on volatile trading revenue.
events.direction: Bullish on strong net deposits, assets, volumes, crypto economics, and a clean outlook; bearish if activity or monetization weakens while expenses rise.
events.magnitude: The July 31 $95 call-plus-put marked about $10.88 at the July 24 close, implying roughly ±11.5% around a $94.61 after-hours stock mark. Indicative, not an executable fill.
events.action: Monitor the release and call. Compare net deposits, platform assets, equity/options/crypto volumes, Gold growth, revenue mix, and expense guidance before changing the thesis.
events.invalidation: A low-information quarter where headline beats are driven by transient market activity but durable deposit and asset trends do not improve.
events.watch: Whether the first reaction survives the call; FOMC headlines earlier that day can contaminate the move.

events.title: July Employment Situation
events.implication: A hot report can revive rate pressure; a weak report can help duration but raise recession risk. HOOD is the highest-beta read-through, while ABT is the defensive relative-value name.
events.direction: Hot wages/jobs: usually bearish duration. Soft but orderly: usually supportive. Abrupt deterioration: risk-off despite lower yields.
events.magnitude: Macro reaction only; no unsupported single-stock percentage is assigned.
events.action: Record payrolls, unemployment, wage growth, and revisions. Separate the rates response from the growth response.
events.invalidation: A consensus-like release with small revisions and little bond-market movement.
events.watch: 2-year yield, QQQ versus XLV, and whether HOOD confirms or rejects the macro move.

events.title: Hims & Hers Q2 2026 earnings
events.implication: This is the first clean management checkpoint after the July PCAC meeting and amid continuing GLP-1 compounding uncertainty. Revenue quality, guidance, and the legal/regulatory path matter more than a one-quarter EPS print.
events.direction: Bullish if revenue lands above the $680M–$700M guide, margins hold, and management gives a credible compliant growth path; bearish if GLP-1 pressure, churn, or regulatory exposure forces a guide cut.
events.magnitude: The August 14 $28 call-plus-put marked about $6.23 at the July 24 close, implying roughly ±22.3% around a $27.99 after-hours stock mark. Liquidity was uneven, so treat this as indicative.
events.action: Monitor subscribers, revenue per subscriber, gross margin, adjusted EBITDA, weight-loss mix, guidance, and every answer on compounding and FDA compliance. No pre-commitment to direction.
events.invalidation: A headline beat without evidence that the post-shortage product mix is durable or compliant.
events.watch: Any pre-earnings FDA/Federal Register action can supersede the normal earnings setup.

events.title: July Consumer Price Index
events.implication: This is the first major inflation check after the July FOMC meeting and can rapidly reprice September policy odds. HOOD and HIMS carry more duration sensitivity than ABT.
events.direction: Hot core CPI is bearish high-duration equities; cooler inflation is supportive unless paired with a sharp growth scare.
events.magnitude: Macro event; use the rates and index reaction rather than inventing a ticker-specific expected move.
events.action: Compare headline, core, shelter, and services inflation with the bond move. Do not trade the first number in isolation.
events.invalidation: A near-consensus print with offsetting components and little change in September rate odds.
events.watch: 2-year yield, QQQ/SPY breadth, XLV relative strength, and revisions to the post-FOMC narrative.

events.title: FDA follow-through on GLP-1 bulk-drug policy
events.implication: Formal FDA action affecting semaglutide, tirzepatide, or liraglutide compounding would be immediately material to the HIMS narrative, but there is no confirmed release date. This belongs on the watchlist, not the calendar.
events.direction: Restrictions or enforcement are bearish HIMS; a clearer lawful personalization pathway is bullish.
events.magnitude: No defensible percentage without a dated action and exact scope. The HIMS earnings straddle shows the market already expects high volatility.
events.action: Check FDA and Federal Register publications every trading morning for named-drug and 503A/503B actions; alert only on a new primary-source document.
events.invalidation: A notice that does not change HIMS' actual legal or operating pathway, or merely repeats existing policy.
events.watch: Final scope, effective date, enforcement discretion, and whether the action applies to 503A pharmacies, 503B outsourcing facilities, or both.

context: Core universe is HIMS plus current Robinhood equity/option underlyings HOOD and ABT; no quantities or account identifiers are published.
ABT has no confirmed company-specific hard catalyst inside the next eight weeks. Its next Robinhood earnings date is October 14, 2026 and remains tentative, so it is excluded from the event list.
July 24 closing data showed unusually high event risk: the HOOD July 31 ATM straddle implied about 11.5%, while the HIMS August 14 ATM straddle implied about 22.3%.
Only material events scoring at least 0.40 are shown. Exact dates are separated from tentative windows and unscheduled watches.
methodology: Daily calendar preload across official company IR, SEC/FDA/Federal Register, Federal Reserve, BLS, Robinhood quotes/earnings/options, and high-signal news or X only when it adds information. Primary-source dates win. Each event is classified, scored for materiality, mapped to likely direction and an explicit monitoring action, and kept future-focused.
